errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die Jahre in zweijährlichen Abständen dar
errors.evidence: The description states that the horizontal axis represents the years in two-year intervals. While the axis labels are indeed every two years, the chart displays one bar for each year from 2000 to 2024 (25 bars in total), not just for every other year. This misrepresents the frequency of the data shown.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in einem einheitlichen hellblauen Farbton gehalten
errors.evidence: This statement claims the bars have a uniform color, which is incorrect. The last two bars in the chart (for the years 2023 and 2024) are a visibly lighter shade of blue than the preceding ones.
The description states the horizontal reference line is at 'approximately 60%'. The line is precisely on the 60% grid line, so the word 'etwa' (approximately) is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: was möglicherweise eine visuelle Unterscheidung für bestimmte Jahre oder Datenpunkte andeutet
errors.evidence: This phrase speculates about the potential meaning of the lighter bar color, which is an interpretation. The prompt explicitly asks to avoid making inferences or drawing conclusions.
The description vaguely states that 'some bars' have a lighter color, without specifying that it is the last two bars (for 2023 and 2024). This is an ambiguous description of a highlighted feature.
